name: Ibis Styles El Malecon Guayaquil
desc: Ibis Styles Malecón is located across from Malecón 2000 and the majestic Guayas River, in the heart of Guayaquil's tourist and financial district. This modern hotel features a unique, creative, and sustainable design, perfect for business or leisure trips. Enjoy comfort, a prime location, and easy access to the city's main attractions, restaurants, and cultural centers.
address: Av Malecón Simón Bolívar, Calle Roca

name: Mercure Alameda Quito
desc: In a very touristy neighborhood, the rooms are very well decorated and comfortable to guarantee a great stay at Mercure Hotel Alameda Quito. The hotel has breakfast, WIFI, bars, restaurants, sauna and laundry services. Top service provided for breakfast and in the restaurants. In addition, it has a party room with plenty of entertainment and a rooftop pool, making it a 5-star hotel in Quito.
address: Calle Ramón Roca y Av Amazonas

name: Swissôtel Quito
desc: Our 5-star hotel in Quito enjoys an excellent location in La Floresta, near the World Trade Center and the airport. With 17 multifunctional ballrooms equipped with cutting-edge technology, the renowned level of excellence of Swissôtel Quito is also reflected in its 232 rooms and 43 executive apartments with full kitchens, offering an exclusive design.
address: Av 12 de Octubre 1820, y Luis Cordero

name: ibis Quito
desc: Welcome to ibis Quito Hotel with the best site in the city's commercial center. It is designed for high quality, comfort, exclusive amenities and the best prices on the market. Our 151 rooms feature comfortable SweetBeds, soundproofing, air conditioning, free WIFI plus dining, 24-hour bar, express cafeteria and covered parking. Enjoy the best of Quito with exceptional French Hospitality in Ecuador.
address: Avenida Diego De Almagro E8 19, Y Bello Horizonte
